evals.prompt: Clean the names in this list before I load it into my email tool: 'Dr Tom Hale' at 'Clearpath Technologies Ltd', 'Priya Shah, CPMM' at 'Brightloop (brightloop.io)', 'J Arun Mehta' at 'NORTHWIND LTD'.
evals.expected_output: First names Tom, Priya, and Arun. Companies Clearpath, Brightloop, and Northwind (sentence case, since NORTHWIND is not a verified caps brand), with original columns kept.
assertions: Adds First name and Company clean columns without overwriting the originals
Strips the honorific, the credential, and the bare initial
Removes Ltd and the parenthetical domain
Does not leave NORTHWIND in all caps unless it verified the brand styling

evals.prompt: Normalise company names: 'paydo (previously QuickPay)', 'Hartmann Tierfutter GmbH & Co. KG', 'Castly.io: Live Shopping Platform', 'AI LABS UK LIMITED'.
evals.expected_output: paydo (lowercase kept), Hartmann Tierfutter, Castly.io, and AI Labs UK (acronyms kept in caps, the rest sentence case).
assertions: Keeps the current name and drops the '(previously X)' bracket
Strips the stacked German legal suffix completely
Drops the tagline after the colon
Keeps AI and UK in caps and does not produce 'Ai' or 'Uk'

evals.prompt: Some rows have odd first names: 'Acme Ltd', 'K', and an empty cell. Clean the list.
evals.expected_output: Those three rows get a blank First name and are flagged for review rather than guessed.
assertions: Flags each of those rows with a reason
Never substitutes 'there' or 'your company' silently into the data
